subject: Brex: 66 articles across 31 lists
body:
One account in the graph, Brex, reads 66 articles across 31 publications, with mentions moving from 17 to 27 between consecutive thirty day windows. Each of those is a publication, an article, a date and a link back.

That is what a signal looks like when it has provenance: a time series per account, not a mention count.

I can pull it for a handful of accounts you already score, so the lift is testable before it becomes a source.
